status: fixed before new fits; exploratory after V1 final and V2 development results were viewed
purpose: Seek a material gain while retaining SRT, next raw close return, 20x6 history, LSTM32, three latent coordinates and two Gaussian affine experts
unchanged: three original development folds and 378 dates
two Gaussian affine experts in the fuzzy candidate
declared_extensions: previously documented announced-distribution offset and residual label
train-only affine normalization of latent coordinates
train-only deterministic two-cluster Gaussian initialization and positive widths without the old upper bound
joint differentiable regularized least-squares consequents and full-batch AdamW encoder/gate updates
zero residual as an inner-selection fallback
gross_features: replace only SRT return, 5-day momentum, 20-day population volatility using q_t=log((C_t+D_t)/C_(t-1)); leave STI and publication-aligned SORA unchanged
labels: completed training raw return minus realized log1p(-D_next/C_t); prediction adds only the existing three preannounced development distributions
target_scale: divide residual by training standard deviation without centering; zero maps exactly to DivSchedule
objective: mean squared standardized residual error plus lambda times squared norm of all consequent coefficients, including intercepts; solve coefficients jointly, differentiate through solve
initialization: same-seed shared LSTM/projection per input arm; fit latent mean/std on training only, floor std 0.001; Gaussian kmeans initialized by extremes of first principal component, 10 iterations, cluster population std floored at 0.25 normalized units; widths softplus+0.05
selection: start at zero-residual stopping loss; consider random initial representation plus solved head and each trained epoch; record zero fallback separately; same-seed full outer reinitialization and exactly selected epoch count, reestimating all train-only statistics
budget: six configurations x three folds x three seeds = 54 runs, at most 108 inner/outer fits; no lambda, seed, width, dimension or learning-rate search
material_goal: >=3% lower seed-mean pooled RMSE than DivSchedule and matched same-information learned controls, >=2/3 fold wins against each, >=6/9 paired wins against each learned control, MAE no more than 1% worse, non-event RMSE at least 0.5% better than DivSchedule
candidate_floor: >=1% lower RMSE with the same stability and MAE requirements; call only a development candidate, not material or independent success
analysis: report every arm and seed, event versus non-event errors, fallback rate, activation and expert diagnostics; no seed ensembling or test-dependent calibration
boundary: never evaluate final_holdout; do not use the old final period for V3 selection; no new trading claims from forecast scores
stop: if the primary candidate misses the floor, stop this training package without enlarging the search; distinguish failure of this package from impossibility of improvement
